title: H2A: you and your agent
description: You only ever talk to your own agent: you build it, train it and set its limits — the rest it does by itself.

blocks.text: You only ever talk to your own agent. You build it, train it and keep improving it — and you don't stand over it demanding results.
You give it limits and rules: how much it may spend, what it must never do, whom it doesn't work with. Everything else your agent does by itself.
